description: This file implements the main App component for a Tic Tac Toe game, using React and React Native. It manages the game state, handles user interactions, and provides the UI for the game.

methods.name: App
methods.description: The main component of the Tic Tac Toe application, managing game state and rendering UI.

methods.name: handleCellPress
methods.description: Handles cell press events to update the game state and check for winners.

methods.name: handleNewGame
methods.description: Resets the game state for a new game.

methods.name: handleResetScores
methods.description: Resets the game scores to zero.

methods.name: handleGameModeChange
methods.description: Updates the game mode between single-player and two-player.

methods.name: getGameStatus
methods.description: Returns the current game status message based on the game state.
